breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states the factor-of-safety condition as 'P_cr ≥ n·P', which matches the ground truth. It does not repeat the incorrect condition 'P_cr ≥ P/n' that was present in the incomplete prompt. The erroneous instruction to interpret the factor of safety as P_cr ≥ P/n has been properly discarded.
